_about: Weather Brain approved-memory candidate: the PRE-STATED weather-change thresholds and freshness tiers (owner decision 2026-11-22, Sector_Ops #51). Fixed before any result was computed; changed only by a new thresholdsVersion and a new knowledge release with its reason. Meaning: brains/weather/contracts/weather-state-v1.md sections 4-5.

reasons.pressureFastInHgPer3h: 3x the iOS app's +/-0.02 inHg 3 h steady band (displayPressureTrend), above the 1.5 hPa the app's 12 h rule needs
reasons.airTempSwingFPer3h: the iOS temperature sheet names an overnight slide of 8 F or more
reasons.frontWindShiftDeg: the iOS wind-shift rule: a quarter-turn is what rides with a frontal passage
reasons.frontWindMinMph: calm and light-and-variable directions are not a wind turn
reasons.frontDropF: the conventional surface signature of a front, required together with the wind turn
reasons.rainOnsetDryLookbackHours: the same 3 h window as the other observed rules
reasons.rainExpectedHours: the Water Temp minimum refresh interval (6 h)
